resources.name: Experimental crystal structure CIFs for six pDPU compounds

access.notes: CCDC deposition codes: 1554302 (pCyDPU), 676835 (pCyNDPU), 1554299 (pCF₃DPU), 1554301 (pCyHDPU), 676839 (pNHDPU), 1554300 (pClHDPU). Individual CIFs can be downloaded using these codes.
Available from the Basis Set Exchange.
Any code that implements periodic B3LYP with Grimme D2 dispersion correction and supports pob-TZVP basis, e.g., CP2K, Quantum ESPRESSO, ORCA.
Included natively in most modern DFT codes.
